terminal_record.title: DOGE Lease List Targets 47 SSA Sites; SSA Says Most Were Unstaffed Hearing Rooms
terminal_record.description_short: AP reported 47 SSA locations on a lease-cancellation list, with 26 listed for 2025; SSA said most were unstaffed hearing rooms.
terminal_record.description_medium: AP reported March 19 that DOGE’s lease-cancellation list included 47 SSA locations, with 26 expected to close during 2025. On March 27, SSA said no local field office had been permanently closed or announced for closure since January 1, and said most listed sites were unstaffed hearing rooms. The record supports a planned lease action, not the original claim that 600 field offices closed or a documented loss of service.
terminal_record.description_long: On March 19, 2025, the Associated Press reported that DOGE had listed 47 Social Security Administration offices for lease cancellation and that 26 entries were expected to close during the year, based on General Services Administration data. This was a plan tied to lease terminations, not proof that 47 public field offices had permanently closed. SSA responded on March 27 that no local field office had been permanently closed or announced for permanent closure since January 1. The agency said most sites identified to GSA were small hearing rooms without assigned employees; it separately said it had announced closure of one hearing office in White Plains, New York. The available records support a proposed lease-termination effort at SSA locations, with facility types and dates varying across the list. They do not support the original claim that about 600 of roughly 1,200 field offices were closed. The sources reviewed also do not establish that every lease cancellation occurred or quantify resulting service loss, delays, or harm to claimants. This entry records the plan and the agency’s contemporaneous correction; outcomes at individual locations remain uncertain.

impact_proposal.confidence_reason: AP reported the GSA lease list and expected dates, while SSA’s contemporaneous statement clarified that most listed sites were unstaffed hearing rooms and no local field-office closures had yet occurred or been announced.
impact_proposal.rationale: The reports document a proposed lease-termination effort involving dozens of SSA sites, but most identified rooms were unstaffed and the agency said no local field office had closed or been announced for closure by March 27. The sources establish neither completed service loss nor misconduct, so harm and institutional effects are scored conservatively and abuse/self-dealing remain zero.
impact_proposal.basis: AP reported 47 listed SSA offices and 26 expected 2025 lease terminations; SSA said most sites were unstaffed hearing rooms and denied local field-office closures through March 27.
